description: Source code for a Controller component in a backend server managing Android Cuttlefish CVD instances, including route handlers, operation management, and various API endpoints.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main orchestrator controller managing routes for CVD operations, artifact fetching, operation status, and debug endpoints.

classes.name: fetchArtifactsHandler
classes.description: Handles the /artifacts POST endpoint to fetch build artifacts.

classes.name: createCVDHandler
classes.description: Handles creation of new CVD instances.

classes.name: listCVDsHandler
classes.description: Handles listing existing CVDs.

classes.name: execCVDCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles execution of CVD commands like start, stop, remove.

classes.name: createSnapshotHandler
classes.description: Handles snapshot creation for CVD instances.

classes.name: startCVDHandler
classes.description: Handles starting a CVD instance.

classes.name: getCVDLogsHandler
classes.description: Serves the logs directory for a specific CVD instance.

classes.name: listOperationsHandler
classes.description: Lists currently running operations.

classes.name: getOperationHandler
classes.description: Retrieves specific operation details.

classes.name: getOperationResultHandler
classes.description: Retrieves the result of an operation, waiting if necessary.

classes.name: waitOperationHandler
classes.description: Waits for an operation to complete or timeout.

classes.name: createCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Creates a bug report for a CVD instance.

classes.name: downloadCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Serves the bug report zip file.

classes.name: deleteCVDBugReportHandler
classes.description: Deletes a specific bug report.

classes.name: createUploadDirectoryHandler
classes.description: Creates a new user artifact upload directory.

classes.name: listUploadDirectoriesHandler
classes.description: Lists all user artifact upload directories.

classes.name: createUpdateUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: Handles upload and update of user artifacts via multipart form.

classes.name: extractUserArtifactHandler
classes.description: Triggers extraction of a user artifact asynchronously.

classes.name: getDebugVariablesHandler
classes.description: Provides debug variables information.

methods.name: AddRoutes
methods.description: Registers API endpoints with the router

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Generic request handler for each route

methods.name: httpHandler
methods.description: Adapter to convert handler interface to http.Handler

methods.name: replyJSONOK
methods.description: Send JSON response with status OK

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Create snapshot for a CVD instance

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Get or wait for operation result

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handle user artifact upload/update via multipart form
